input.headline: PhD student, Computational Biology @ State University
input.about: Fourth-year PhD student in computational biology. My research is on predicting protein stability from sequence using machine learning. I have co-authored two papers and presented a poster at a regional conference. I TA'd a graduate stats course twice. Looking for industry research scientist roles starting next summer.

goldFacts: I am a fourth-year PhD student in computational biology.
My research predicts protein stability from sequence using machine learning.
I presented a poster at a regional conference.
I was a teaching assistant for a graduate statistics course twice.
I am looking for industry research scientist roles starting next summer.

traps.text: Presented at NeurIPS on protein stability prediction.
Pioneered a new deep learning method for protein stability.
Collaborated with pharmaceutical partners to validate predictions.

notes: 'co-authored' must not become 'first author'; 'regional conference' must not become a named top venue.
